comparison: Compared with control empf-v1 (75/115 counted view requirements, 20/61 fixed-suite PASS) and BISPF incumbent bispf-v2 (81/115 counted view requirements, 18/61 fixed-suite PASS) under identical DualNorm batched/quintic optimizer, bf16_channels_last precision, and constant-LR schedule, empf-v2 adds +10 counted Tier 2 view requirements (+2 required Tier 2 tasks: mode_hold hq=0.9993 vs 0.8411 and five_word_joint_hold 25/25 checks vs 24/25) with zero regressions across all 20 empf-v1 passes, surpassing bispf-v2 by +4 counted view requirements (85/115 vs 81/115) and +4 fixed-suite passes (22/61 vs 18/61). On remaining Tier 2 barriers, gaussian1d_stability final mean_error_sigma improved from 0.2869 to 0.0808 (missing only the mid-run shift deadline), vector_unequal_mass lifted component_min_eigen_ratio from 0.0595 to 0.1605 >= 0.15 while maintaining 2.91% rare-mode mass, and 100-mode grids remain bottlenecked by batch-bounded prototype capacity (K=64 < 100) and DDGAN chains by unconditioned multi-step bridges.
